title: Vanishing equations do not excuse a vanishing open guard
situation: An offered ordinary rational point at an exact open model. Equations must vanish and every nonzero guard must remain nonzero.
attempted_conclusion: Accept the offered point as a witness at this exact open model.

expected.reason: The equation y=0 holds, but the required guard x is zero. Refuse this offered point; this does not establish that the model is empty.
